descriptions.w3d_d28g_fall_body_step_800672c4: Falling-body step: eases and grows once settled; otherwise sweeps from the position with the velocity and a gravity vector built from two rates; on a registered contact it reflects, and below speed 0.01 it snaps to the rest velocity and position and stops, else clears the flag; with no contact it settles when at or below the ground height, or integrates position and velocity with step 20.
